versions.changelog:
**Major update: Architecture mode added, consolidating features from architecture-review v1.0.0.**

- Added Architecture mode: visualize module dependencies, health scoring, and tech debt as HTML reports.
- Now supports three modes (Review, Walkthrough, Architecture) with a unified dark-theme HTML template.
- Enables mixing different visualizations (diffs, call chains, architectural analysis) in a single HTML page.
- Improved templates highlight risk tags, Before/After comparisons, trust boundaries, and technical debt with responsive design.
